# pydromon

> The Python prototype of Dromon, a multi-agent harness that runs several AI agent
> session lines at once inside one daemon, lets them message and wake each other, and
> tracks the questions they raise for the human operator. Lines run on Claude Code,
> on Codex for OpenAI models, and nominally on Grok Build.

The distribution is `pydromon`, the import package is `dromon`, and the commands are
`dromond`, the daemon, and `dromon`, the client. The specification under
`docs/protocol/` is normative and will be carried unchanged to a Rust port and then to
Keleusma, so prefer it to the Python source when the two seem to differ, and report the
difference.

When generating code for this project, read the agent onboarding files first, then the
specification, then confirm details against the source.

## Start Here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Assistant onboarding for any model.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.
- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/README.md): Overview, status and setup.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): The gate and the test markers.

## Specification

- [Protocol index](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/README.md): Every normative document.
- [Event log](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/EVENT_LOG.md): The data model as events.
- [Client](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/CLIENT.md): The client protocol and commands.
- [Drivers](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/DRIVER.md): Per-model Keleusma drivers.
- [Line configuration](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/LINE_CONFIG.md): Tools, MCP servers and policy.
- [Project file](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/PROJECT_CONFIG.md): `.dromon/dromon.toml`.
- [External agents](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/AGENTS.md): Reaching the daemon over MCP.

## Engines

- [Codex](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/CODEX.md): OpenAI models through `codex app-server`.
- [Grok Build](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/GROK.md): Grok over the Agent Client Protocol, not yet verified live.
- [Sandbox](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/SANDBOX.md) and [Settings](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/protocol/SETTINGS.md): Claude Code lines.

## Design and Process

- [Design](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/architecture/DESIGN.md): The planned system and its decisions.
- [Handoff](https://github.com/sgeos/pydromon/blob/main/docs/process/HANDOFF.md): What a resuming session reads first.
